title: Data Centres (SPICe Spotlight briefing)
notes: Covers Cato (280,000 m2, 35 m, 400-4,000 GWh/yr), Larbert (128,863 m2), Rufus (540 MW), Gogar (200 MW); Scotland generated 51.8 TWh in 2024 (91.5% renewable); cites APRS mapping of 26 proposals.

title: Data Centre Map (Scotland proposals tracker)
perspective: Campaign group advocating a moratorium; useful census but figures must be verified against planning records
notes: 26 projects with per-site pages linking planning documents. No downloadable dataset.

title: Proposed Data Centre Connection Reforms (consultation)
notes: Demand connection queue grew 41 GW to 125 GW (Nov 2024 - Jun 2025), ~80 GW attributed to data centres. Proposes commitment fee of GBP 237,500-712,500/MW. Closes 16 Sep 2026. Aggregate figures only; no project-level demand register.

title: Green Datacentres and Digital Connectivity: Vision and Action Plan for Scotland
perspective: Government strategy promoting Scotland as a data-hosting location

title: AI Growth Zones written statement HLWS1290 (Lanarkshire designation)
notes: Designates Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone centred on DataVita Chapelhall/Airdrie sites with CoreWeave anchor; 500 MW AI-ready capacity, >1 GW private-wire renewables, GBP 8.2bn claim.

title: Transmission Entry Capacity (TEC) Register
notes: CSV/API, updated twice weekly. Generation-focused; NESO confirmed via FOI that no public register of demand connections exists — the data-centre demand queue is not project-level public data.

title: Planning application P/26/0237/FUL — Construction of an AI Data Centre with 300MW Demand Utility Capacity, Land to the northeast of Glenbervie Nursery, Stirling Road, Larbert
notes: Received 2026-05-29, validated 2026-06-04, status 'Awaiting decision'. Portal showed 7,130 comments, 133 documents, 6 constraints at retrieval. Direct applicationDetails URL requires the record keyVal; use reference search.

title: Planning Statement for P/26/0237/FUL (portal document 1644123, mirrored by APRS)
publisher: Apatura / Falkirk Council portal (mirrored by Action to Protect Rural Scotland)
notes: Could not be downloaded during this research session (APRS bot-protection captcha); cited only as corroboration that the application reference is P/26/0237/FUL. No values were taken from it.

title: Plans submitted to Falkirk Council for Larbert Data Centre Campus
Larbert AI Data Campus — public consultation project page and timeline
notes: Timeline: grid offer accepted Q2 2025; consultations Q4 2025; application Q2 2026; remediation Q3 2026; construction 2027-2028; operations 2029. Describes ~50 acres of mainly vacant grassland beside Glenbervie Business Park.

title: SPICe Spotlight: Data Centres
notes: States Larbert campus comprises two data centre buildings of 128,863 m2 floor area, 25 m high (flues to 28 m), plus an 11,500 m2 electricity substation and associated facilities.

title: 'You don't want this where you live': Fears over plans for massive AI data centre in Larbert
notes: Reports 200 backup diesel generators with 48-hour fuel supply, closed-loop cooling, 'district heat ready' design, 1,100+ objections at time of writing, campaign groups and public meeting of 25 June 2026, 21-day comment period ending 2026-07-02, pre-determination hearing required.

title: Deadline approaches for views on 'humungous' planned data centres in Falkirk and Fife
notes: Consultation deadline 2026-07-02; 3,100+ objections at time of writing; Larbert (300MW) and Auchtertool, Fife (600MW) together 900MW.

title: Larbert AI Data Centre: what happens next after more than 6,700 objections?
notes: Reports (via search excerpt; page itself returned 403) applicant Apatura DC Project 5 Ltd; 6,833 comments of which 6,719 objections and 80 support as of consultation close 2026-07-02.

title: Apatura changes location of planned 300MW data center campus in Scotland
notes: Reports (via search excerpt; page returned 403) the 300MW campus was originally proposed on agricultural land near Plean, Stirling, and was relocated ~3 miles to Glenbervie Business Centre, Larbert, in October 2025.

title: Falkirk could be site of one of largest datacentres in the UK — with plans for development submitted to council
notes: Reports 'Gate 2 compliant grid connections', Denny substation, Scottish Enterprise landowner, jobs and investment claims.

title: Apatura submits plans for Larbert data centre campus
notes: Includes Scottish Enterprise quote (Victoria Carmichael) and Apatura CEO Giles Hanglin; district heat-ready design; BESS connection 2 miles north; 1.6GW confirmed connections across Apatura pipeline.

title: Build of proposed Larbert data centre would create over 5,000 construction jobs

perspective: Campaign group opposed to hyperscale data centres in Scotland
